name: Stress Recovery Theory
short_description: Theory positing that rapid, automatic affective responses to natural scenes drive physiological stress reduction.

components.name: Immediate Affect
components.description: Initial, automatic positive emotional reaction to a scene.

components.name: Parasympathetic Dominance

components.name: Cortisol Reduction
components.description: Decreased levels of stress hormones in the bloodstream.
